acceptance_criteria: <observable behavior that must hold when the task is done>
verification_expectations: <focused tests or commands that prove the criteria>
out_of_scope: <related work this task deliberately does not do>
notes: Optional fields: required_reviews (review lanes that must run in addition to the classified ones; remove it when classification is enough), acceptance_criteria, verification_expectations, out_of_scope, validation_strategy. Set status to approved when the plan is ready, then save it with `task plan save <task-id> --input <file>`.
